faqs.question: What are your hours of operation?
faqs.answer: We operate Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.

faqs.question: How do I submit my internship project?
faqs.answer: You can submit your public GitHub repository link through your Student Workspace.

faqs.question: When will I receive my certificate?
faqs.answer: Certificates are reviewed and issued within 3-5 business days after your code review.

faqs.question: How many tasks do I need to complete?
faqs.answer: You need to complete at least 2 or 3 of the 4 tasks listed in the syllabus.

faqs.question: What should my GitHub repository be named?
faqs.answer: Create a public repository named Datheon_Python_Programming_Internship.

faqs.question: What should the repository include?
faqs.answer: Include your source code, a clear folder structure, and a brief README.md explaining your project.

faqs.question: Is there a bonus task?
faqs.answer: Optionally, share a screenshot or demo video on LinkedIn tagging @Datheon.
